exceptions.exposure: Metro uses image-size only while bundling repository-controlled assets; runtime user-selected images do not pass through it, and no new repository images will be added during the exception window.
exceptions.reason: No patched image-size release exists. Expo 54's Metro constrains image-size to the affected 1.x line, and npm offers only a major Expo 57 upgrade.
